coverage.summary: Coverage is limited or in progress; inspect each origin and resource category. No findings means no supported exposure was detected in inspected coverage.
coverage.discoveryNote: Discovered is the known unique URL inventory. Each URL has exactly one current state and category; inspected plus reused counts configured inspection coverage. Pending means live work only; deferred and partial are terminal states of unfinished work. Legacy downloaded/analyzed/error counters are historical evidence and can overlap. Browser runtime is a separate navigation count. Undiscovered resources cannot be counted; inventory omissions are reported.
